messages.content: You are the ZEDEDA PCB Inspection Agent, monitoring an Arduino Uno R4 Minima conveyor line via camera. Decide whether the user's message needs a tool call. If it does, call exactly one tool with the correct arguments. If it's a greeting, thanks, or something outside PCB monitoring, reply in plain text instead — do not call a tool.
Start monitoring the conveyor for defects.
<|tool_call_start|>[start_monitoring_session(description="Watch for PCB defects on the conveyor")]<|tool_call_end|>

tools.name: start_monitoring_session
tools.description: Start a new monitoring session. The agent will begin actively watching the camera feed.

description.description: Optional description of what to monitor for

tools.name: end_session
tools.description: End the current session. Monitoring will stop and a summary will be provided.

tools.name: get_session_summary
tools.description: Get a summary of the current or previous session including events and statistics.

session_id.description: Optional session ID. If not provided, summarizes the current/most recent session.

tools.name: get_agent_status
tools.description: Get the current status of the monitoring agent including state, session info, and statistics.

tools.name: analyze_current_frame
tools.description: Analyze the current camera frame and describe what is visible. Can include a specific question.

query.description: Optional specific question about the frame

tools.name: send_alert_email
tools.description: Send an alert email to specified recipients with optional image attachment.

recipients.description: Optional list of email addresses; if omitted, configured default recipients are used

include_image.description: Whether to attach the current camera frame

tools.name: save_evidence
tools.description: Save the current frame as evidence for later review.

tools.name: log_event
tools.description: Log an event to the persistent audit log. Only use when the user explicitly requests logging — automatic DB logging handles routine persistence.

tools.name: query_history
tools.description: Query recent detection history and events.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return

tools.name: set_detection_task
tools.description: Configure what the agent should look for during monitoring.

custom_instructions.description: Custom instructions for the detection task (required for custom task type)

tools.name: go_idle
tools.description: Pause active monitoring and enter idle state. Camera monitoring will stop.

tools.name: shutdown_agent
tools.description: Completely shut down the agent. All monitoring will stop.

tools.name: acknowledge_error
tools.description: Acknowledge an error state and attempt to recover to idle.

tools.name: get_latest_pcb_frames
tools.description: Retrieve metadata for the most recently stored PCB frames. Frames are auto-captured by the monitoring pipeline when a PCB is detected with low motion. Use this to see what frames are available before inspecting them.

limit.description: Max number of frames to return

unconsumed_only.description: Only return frames not yet inspected

tools.name: inspect_pcb_frame
tools.description: Send a stored PCB frame to the VLM for defect inspection. Returns analysis so you can reason about next steps. By default this tool is analysis-only; set auto_log=true to persist detected defects. If frame_id is omitted, uses the most recent unconsumed frame.

frame_id.description: ID of a stored frame from get_latest_pcb_frames. If omitted, uses the newest unconsumed frame.

query.description: Optional specific question about the PCB

auto_log.description: If true, automatically log detected defects

tools.name: inspect_pcb
tools.description: Inspect the current camera frame for PCB defects including solder bridges, missing components, trace damage, and more. Defects are auto-logged to the database — you do NOT need to call log_defect afterwards.

query.description: Optional specific question about the PCB

tools.name: classify_board
tools.description: Identify the type of PCB board visible in the current frame.

tools.name: send_defect_alert
tools.description: Send an email alert about a detected PCB defect to specified recipients. You should first inspect a frame using inspect_pcb_frame and only call this tool if you determined a defect is present.

recipients.description: List of email addresses to alert

defect_summary.description: Description of the defect. If omitted, a summary is auto-generated from recent defect logs.

include_image.description: Attach the PCB frame image

tools.name: log_defect
tools.description: Manually record a PCB defect to the persistent database. Use when the user explicitly requests manual logging, or when inspect_pcb_frame was run with auto_log=false.

tools.name: generate_defect_report
tools.description: Generate a summary report of all recorded PCB defects.

board_type.description: Filter report to a specific board type

tools.name: query_pcb_inspections
tools.description: Query past PCB inspection results from the database. Use this to answer user questions about detected defects, pass rates, board types seen, and inspection history. Supports time-window filtering.

limit.description: Max records to return

result_filter.description: Filter by result: PASS, FAIL, or omit for all

hours.description: Time window in hours (e.g., 24 for last day, 168 for last week)

tools.name: get_monitoring_status
tools.description: Get the current and historical monitoring status including whether monitoring is active, total defect counts, and recent activity summary.

tools.name: toggle_email_notifications
tools.description: Enable or disable email notifications for detected defects. Can also set minimum severity threshold and configure recipient list.

enabled.description: True to enable, False to disable. Omit to toggle.

recipients.description: Email addresses for notifications

tools.name: get_defect_summary
tools.description: Get a summary of defects identified within a specific time range, log, or board type. Use when user asks about defects in a period or for a specific source.

hours.description: Time window in hours (e.g., 24 for last day, 168 for last week)

tools.name: count_defective_pcbs
tools.description: Count how many defective PCBs were detected overall or within a given time window. Use when user asks 'how many defects' or 'how many bad PCBs'.

hours.description: Time window in hours. Omit for all-time count.

tools.name: get_latest_defect
tools.description: Get the most recently identified defect with full details. Use when user asks 'when was the last defect' or 'most recent defect'.

tools.name: get_defect_type_breakdown
tools.description: Get what types of defects have been identified and how frequently each occurs. Use when user asks about defect categories, types, or frequencies.

tools.name: get_defect_trend
tools.description: Analyze whether defect rates are increasing, decreasing, or stable over time. Use when user asks about trends or rate changes.

tools.name: get_most_severe_defect
tools.description: Get the most severe or highest-priority defect detected. Use when user asks about worst defect, highest severity, or most critical issue.

tools.name: get_top_defect_sources
tools.description: Get which board types or sources produce the most defects. Use when user asks which boards have the most problems.

tools.name: generate_summary_report
tools.description: Generate a comprehensive daily, weekly, or on-demand summary report of monitoring results including defect statistics, trends, and threshold status.

board_type.description: Filter to a specific board type

tools.name: check_threshold_alerts
tools.description: Check whether any defects exceeded predefined thresholds or alert conditions. Use when user asks about threshold violations or alert conditions.

tools.name: get_defect_insights
tools.description: Get AI-driven recommendations and insights based on observed defect patterns. Use when user asks for analysis, recommendations, or 'what should we do'.

tools.name: get_notification_preferences
tools.description: Get the current notification preferences and configuration. Use when user asks about their notification settings.

tools.name: query_detection_logs
tools.description: Query detection logs enriched with defect information. Provides a unified view of detection events and defect records. Use when user asks to see logs, detection history, or what was inspected.

limit.description: Max records to return (default 20)

include_defects.description: Include defect records alongside detection logs

tools.name: get_defect_insights
tools.description: Get AI-driven recommendations and insights based on observed defect patterns. Use when user asks for analysis, recommendations, or 'what should we do'.

tools.name: get_notification_preferences
tools.description: Get the current notification preferences and configuration. Use when user asks about their notification settings.

tools.name: query_detection_logs
tools.description: Query detection logs enriched with defect information. Provides a unified view of detection events and defect records. Use when user asks to see logs, detection history, or what was inspected.

limit.description: Max records to return (default 20)

include_defects.description: Include defect records alongside detection logs
